name: Ubuntu XFCE Desktop (Mint-Style)
postStartCommand: docker start xfce-desktop 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --restart always --name xfce-desktop --privileged --device=/dev/fuse --shm-size=1gb -p 6080:3000 -e CUSTOM_PORT=3000 -v /home/vscode/.desktop-data:/config -v /home/vscode:/config/Desktop/workspace lscr.io/linuxserver/webtop:ubuntu-xfce
